money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The local currency is Mozambique Metical (MZN). It's illegal to export or import MZN. You can get MZN by exchanging: traveller's cheques, in US dollars or Euros, at major banks in Maputo You can only change traveller's cheques for MZN. It's difficult to change traveller's cheques outside of Maputo. You may be charged a high rate of commission. In Maputo, ATMs will often accept international credit cards. laws.rule: Penalties for drug offences are severe and include prison sentences.
laws.heading: Drugs

laws.rule: By law, you must carry personal identity documents at all times and present them on request to the authorities. Personal ID includes: a passport (must be original, copies are not accepted) other photo ID Keep a digital copy of your ID and all travel documents.
laws.heading: Personal identification

laws.rule: You must have permission to photograph: government buildings other infrastructure officials It's illegal to export or import the local currency, Meticais. You must have a licence to purchase or trade endangered wildlife products, such as ivory and rhino horn.
laws.heading: Other laws

laws.rule: Same-sex relationships are legal, but there are local sensitivities. Avoid public displays of affection.
laws.heading: LGBTQIA+ travellers

laws.rule: To drive, you must have both: a valid Australian driver licence an International Driving Permit (IDP) Get your IDP before leaving Australia.
laws.heading: Driving permit
